description: On the table in front of you are a watercolor palette, a white sheet of paper with a small rainbow-like swatch, a paper cup of rinse water holding a couple of blue-handled brushes, and a folded tissue. The right hand holds a clear-handled brush and moves it into the cup to rinse, then brings it back down and repeatedly dabs and wipes the brush tip on the folded tissue to clean it before returning to paint near the colored swatch.
